name: NOVO transferFrom without allowance check drains the NOVO/WBNB pair
summary: NOVO's transferFrom moves tokens from any sender without spending an allowance (the _approve deduction is commented out). The attacker bought NOVO with flash-swapped WBNB, called transferFrom to move most of the NOVO/WBNB pair's NOVO to the token contract, synced the pair, and sold NOVO into the collapsed reserve for the pair's WBNB, then repeated five blocks later.

loss.notes: Net WBNB depletion of the NOVO/WBNB pair across both attacker transactions; the attacker's own 17.2 WBNB buys each time are netted by measuring from the pre-transaction reserve.

ageReset.description: Fifteenth Upgraded event, activating the exploited NOVO implementation.

sources.note: Loss. Sync events of pair 0x128cd0ae1a0ae7e67419111714155e1b1c6b2d8d (token0 NOVO, token1 WBNB): getReserves at block 18225002 gives WBNB 395001031454274158328; source-1's first Sync is 412201031454274158328 (the attacker's 17.2 WBNB buy) and its last 102728634544729700506, a net 292272396909544457822 drop. Source-5 (block 18225008, index 60, same sender and attack contract) starts from 102728634544729700506 at block 18225007 and ends at 58489498131100692806, a further 44239136413629007700. NOVO Transfer logs from the pair to the NOVO contract, i.e. forced transferFrom pulls, occur only in these two transactions between blocks 18114775 and 18300000.

Root cause, anchor and age. Verified implementation source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, NOVO, v0.8.7; SHA-256 of SourceCode 5031b5f555ff38f0a20f28c404b33bf10a3f41bf67cfa58bc5c26297e485b0e7): transferFrom checks only the sender's staking lock and calls _transfer; the allowance-spending _approve is commented out. Source-1 (block 18225003, index 43) calls transferFrom(pair, NOVO, 113951614.76238437 NOVO), then sync and the sale, as in the PoC (source-2). Age: EIP-1967 implementation slot of TransparentUpgradeableProxy 0x6fb2020c236bbd5a7ddeb07e14c9298642253333 at block 18225002 is the implementation; Etherscan V2 getLogs for Upgraded on the proxy lists fifteen events to block 18225003, the last source-3 (block 18114775). The implementation has no code at block 18114743 and keccak256 of its runtime is the recorded hash at blocks 18114744 and 18225002.
